newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes slightly up, Brent rangebound.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes slightly up, Brent rangebound.

text.p: IPE gas oil dipped in late trade on Wednesday to close slightly up as NYMEX heating oil slipped off highs, traders said.
March gas oil ended $1.00 a tonne higher at $176, off a session high of $177.25.
"Heating oil is pretty much under pressure, because of the weather," said one broker.
Unseasonably warm weather in the key heating oil market of the Northeastern United States was dampening demand, they said.
Trade was lacklustre with traders attending Institute of Petroleum events.
"There's not too much interest around so we're really just stuck in a range," a dealer said.
Brent crude was also rangebound, with April trading 22 cents higher at $20.61 a barrel, having been limited to a 25 cents range. Resistance was pegged at $22.85 and then at $22.96.
Oil markets were focused on the release of American Petroleum Institute (API) weekly U.S. oil stocks data expected after the close of trade on Wednesday.
Traders expected a build in crude stocks of up to four million barrels and an increase in gasoline stocks of up to two million barrels.
